task: Productize Lattice CLI 0.3.5 as the primary host-neutral client and migrate Mac App-only product capabilities into CLI-first surfaces.
outcome: 用户在终端运行 `lattice --version` 看到 `Lattice CLI 0.3.5`，运行 `lattice help` 能看到 host/config/authority/conduit 迁移入口，同时 README 明确写出 Mac App 是 optional dashboard/archive，不再是使用 Lattice 的必需步骤。
facts: 0.3.5 keeps package compatibility while adding a first-class lattice bin/entrypoint; hard npm package rename is deferred to avoid breaking existing installs.
Lattice Conduit in this story is a CLI-visible thin conduit contract/status surface, not a full autonomous model runner; full register/claim/heartbeat can land later behind the same command family.
koala remains a legacy alias in 0.3.5 so existing story tooling and downstream projects keep working while Lattice becomes the public product name.
Existing CLI already has Lattice primitives: capability_list/probe, story_export, handoff, evidence manifest, authority policy discovery.
Server Authority receipts remain the only production authority; local CLI, handoff packs, cache, and Mac UI must not claim productionDone.
constraints: Do not make Lattice Conduit a new coding agent or model runtime.
Preserve koala compatibility as a legacy alias for existing users and story tooling.
Do not bypass Koala story/checklist/evidence commands for story metadata.
Keep production authority fail-closed: accepted transport or local cache is not a verified receipt.
Avoid making Mac App part of release or validation main path.
